story.title: Water Dance
paragraphs_en: Guddu loves to dance. He dances to the cow mooing and to the sound of someone eating.
Drip Drip Drop Drop Drop Gush Gush! “Water, you are full of beats! Let’s see what else you can do.”
Swish Swosh Swish Swosh “Slow down, stream! I can’t keep up with you.”
Burble Burble Burble Burble “I wonder if a river would have a gentler beat! I could bounce about with the river. ”
Whoosh Boom Bash “The ocean may look calm, but the waves must be wild and loud!”
Paf Paf Paf Paaaf “Nothing can be louder than this rain! These raindrops are quick and fast.”
Whoosh Fizz, Whoosh Fuzz “Oh waterfall, you are quite loud too!”
“Mom is skipping stones by the pool. Maybe the pool has a tune too?”
“Why are you dancing, Guddu? ” everyone asks. “ There’s no music.” “There is music and there is rhythm. Just listen to the water! ”
